msg: No AI-use disclosure. Journals following the ICMJE Recommendations ask authors to state whether generative AI was used in writing, and to name the tool and the task.
need: (declaration of generative ai|generative ai (and ai-assisted|in the writing|was used|were used|was not used)|ai[- ]?(use|assisted)[^\n]{0,30}(disclosure|statement|technolog)|no generative ai|did not use (any )?generative ai)
fix: add a short 'Declaration of generative AI in the writing process' section, even to say none was used

msg: A generative-AI tool appears on the author line. Under the ICMJE Recommendations an AI tool cannot be an author, because it cannot take responsibility or declare interests.
fix: move the tool out of the author list and into the AI disclosure section

msg: This manuscript still promises a 12-month embargo. The 2024 NIH Public Access Policy ({since:2026-07-01}) applies to papers accepted for publication on or after that date: the Author Accepted Manuscript goes to PubMed Central and is public on the official date of publication, with no embargo option.
fix: say the accepted manuscript is deposited in PMC and released on the publication date

msg: No data availability statement. Most publishers and every major funder now require one, even when the answer is that no new data were created.
need: (data availability|availability of data|data sharing statement|data and code availability|code availability)
fix: add a 'Data availability' section naming the repository and the accession or DOI

msg: The data availability statement says the data are available from the authors on request. Funder open-access policies and a growing number of journals no longer accept that as the only route.
scope: (data availability|availability of data|data sharing statement|data and code availability)
fix: deposit in a repository and cite the accession or DOI, or state the legal reason access is restricted

msg: The data availability statement carries no locator. A reviewer cannot follow a promise; the statement needs a repository name plus an accession number or a DOI.
scope: (data availability|availability of data|data sharing statement|data and code availability)
fix: add the repository and the accession/DOI, e.g. Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.0000000

msg: No labelled funding statement. Publishers index funding separately from the acknowledgements, and a funder that cannot find its award in the record counts the paper as unreported.
fix: add a 'Funding' section, or state that the work received no specific funding

msg: A funder is named but no award or grant number is given. Funder reporting systems match on the award ID, not the funder name.
when: \b(nih|national institutes of health|nsf|national science foundation|erc|european research council|wellcome|ukri|horizon europe|dfg|nsfc|cihr|arc\b)
fix: add the award ID exactly as the funder issued it

msg: No competing interests statement. The ICMJE disclosure is required from every author, and 'none' has to be written down rather than left out.
need: (competing interest|conflict of interest|conflicts of interest|declaration of interest|disclosure statement)
fix: add 'Competing interests: the authors declare none.' if that is the case

msg: No author contributions statement. CRediT (ANSI/NISO Z39.104-2022) is now collected at submission by most large publishers.
fix: add an 'Author contributions' section using the 14 CRediT roles

msg: The author contributions are written in free prose rather than CRediT roles, so the publisher cannot map them to the taxonomy (ANSI/NISO Z39.104-2022).
fix: rewrite as 'A.B.: Conceptualization, Methodology; C.D.: Formal analysis, Writing - original draft'

msg: No ORCID iD appears anywhere. Several publishers and funders require a verified ORCID for at least the corresponding author at submission.
fix: add the corresponding author's ORCID iD next to their name

msg: The manuscript reports work on people or animals but names no ethics approval. Editors desk-reject on this before the paper reaches a reviewer.
fix: name the approving committee and the protocol number

msg: People took part but no informed-consent statement is present. Consent to participate and, where images or case details appear, consent to publish are separate statements.
need: (informed consent|consent to participate|consent to publish|written consent)
fix: state how consent was obtained, and add consent to publish if any individual is identifiable

msg: A trial is described but no registration identifier is given. ICMJE member journals will not consider an unregistered trial, and registration must predate enrolment.
fix: add the registry and the identifier, e.g. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00000000

msg: No open-access licence is stated. Plan S, UKRI, Horizon Europe and the 2026 NIH policy all expect the accepted manuscript to carry a CC BY or equivalent licence, applied by the author at submission.
fix: add the funder-required licence line, e.g. 'For the purpose of open access, a CC BY public copyright licence is applied to this submission.'
